reason: My guests ask the same three things, Wi-Fi, parking and check-in, and I already have a printed sheet and copy-paste answers on my phone, even in German. Paying €35 a month for each apartment, on top of €150 setup, to answer things I answer myself in two minutes does not make sense for me.
objection: With four apartments that is €140 a month plus €600 just to start, for a robot that sends the hard questions back to my WhatsApp anyway. I am not sure my older German guests would even scan a QR code instead of just writing to me.
would_change_my_mind: A one-time price with no monthly fee, or one price for all my apartments together around €10 a month, and a neighbour host I trust telling me it really cut her August messages in half.
